Data is encoded and
transmitted

to the terminal and decoded
Data is gridded maps -matrces, resolved with gradients using

Interpolated set of parameters through patterns is updated
and given as an iteration of input to a prediction model (gaps
were diagnosed while preserving risen flags (and assessing
gradients)
Predicted set of parameters are
merged into a whole picture.
Picture is checked for conflict flags. Pre-verified
through data bases
Checked picture is stamped with pre-approval by data analysts (ALARM flag is not
risen - warning scenario is not started, priority is checked as low for the data
stream in case of big load)
